test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

ARHT, YOJW, WLLZ, ?, SFPF
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3e36fd3558f7a1ce3a703f394b791bc317d188286d48b293bf93d80328bf4c8.png] 

**Logic:** (2) and (3) subtracted from the first and second letters' positional values and (2) and (3) added in the third and fourth letters' positional values.
